title.narrative: Envelop 1:Support the resilience and access to access to life-saving community-based protection services (GBV )and Livelihoods for the Women, girls , including Women with Disabilities in within the widows' camps in NW Syria.

description.narrative:
WSA implemented activities in Idlib Governorate, Harim District, Dana and Maaret Tamsrin sub-district where we have 3 WGSSs for women and adolescent girls with full GBV activities and regarding the priorities of SA2 2022 to support the widow's camps in NWS. according to HNAP dataset widows camps mapping, WSA has access to 5 widows camps: Idleb , Idleb ,Bennsh, Foah, Hafidat Aa'esha camp Idleb , Harim, Dana ,Kafr Deryan, Tayba camp Idleb , Idleb ,Bennsh, Foah, Aa'esha camp Idleb , Harim,Dana ,Qah, amal Village Idleb , Harim,Dana , Mashhad Ruhin ,Al Khirat camp
Regarding (Hafidat Aa'esha and Tayba) camps, WSA now manages a project with all GBV activities, funded by SCHF and the project will end at the end of June 2023, we planned to expand the activities provided within these two camp based on the needs assessment that was conducted and added activities will be: robot training activities for girls, in addition to income-generating activities, advanced vocational training (level 2) + small grants). and for the 3 other camps: (Aa'esha camp,amal Village, and Al Khirat camp) WSA will provide full GBV activities following: 1-specialized GBV services, Case Management, specialized individual PSS, case workers will follow up with the WampG-GBV survivors, In addition to providing case fund to GBV survivors in accordance with the GBV SC Cash SOPs and referrals to other services(Medical, legal, CP, other referrals) according to the referral paths that are shared by the GBV sub-clusters and creating a service mapping for non-protection services through coordination with actors in the area. 2-Prevention activities: Life skills programs for women and girls (My safety my wellbeing), recreational activities, GBV awareness raising sessions (GBV-SC toolkit), training (literacy - computer-Languages’) for women and girls. 3-Provide robotic activities: Target adolescent girls inside Widows camps. 4-Provide Young Mothers Club Program Targeting married women under 18 in common widows camps. 5-Conduct vocational training for women, such as hairdressing, sewing, wool fabric, Gift and accessory industry, pottery industry,.etc. based on needs.200 women will be targeted in 5 camps, at the end of the training, each trainee will receive In-kind support of value 50 $ (from the lessons learned from similar projects). 6-provide 60 small grants and inclusive livelihood opportunities to a group of women (widows and heads of households in 5 camps) who have been empowered or have ideas for small projects according to specific criteria, with high priority for GBV survivors and women at risk (30%) including women with disabilities, the value for a grant (850 USD) per. 7-safety audit activity to assess and address risk factors related to protecting women and girls from GBV in 3 camps. Women and girls with disabilities will be targeted in all project activities according to their disability and their information will be collected from the registration form. Services will be provided to widows within the WGSSs or activities halls in camps, according to the situation of each camp and the type of services in accordance with Covid -19 and cholera prevention measures. At the launch of the project, WSA will be held introductory sessions to introduce project activities and selection criteria with local councils, local leaders, Widows camp managers, and organizations working in Project areas, the WSA will take into account the opinion of the community and Women and girls in activities.
